The '''Phantom''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] produced by [[Vectron]] during the [[Third Galactic War|renewed conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Vectron Phatom was added to the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] in [[2020]].
